SELECT m.minutes_num, m.team_num, m.schedule_num, m.writer_num, m.title, m.meeting_date, m.content, m.decision_content, m.action_item, m.pdf_path, m.status, m.reg_date, m.modify_date,
u.user_name AS writer_name, s.title AS schedule_title, t.team_name AS team_name
FROM MEETING_MINUTES m
JOIN USERS u ON m.writer_num = u.user_num
JOIN TEAM t ON m.team_num = t.team_num
LEFT JOIN SCHEDULE s ON m.schedule_num = s.schedule_num
WHERE m.minutes_num = #{minutes_num} AND m.status = 1

u.user_name AS writer_name, s.title AS schedule_title, t.team_name AS team_name

JOIN TEAM t ON m.team_num = t.team_num
